items.title: Ben Sidran interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 15, 2023
items.q: I love what Cannonball said. I really, I remember the record. And I remember hearing it the first time

ctx.x: And Tower of Power said, “Hipness is what it is, sometimes it’s what it ain’t.” So Mr. Sidran, can you tell me what is hip?

Tell me, tell me. I love what Cannonball said. I really, I remember the record. And I remember hearing it the first time and saying this man is a teacher boy. What is hip. Yeah you know so don’t cry for no hipster, he knew what he signed up for. The look in the field, the rundown appeal, the passing ship the distant shore. Don’t cry for no hipster, he saw the writing on the wall and it gave him hope, just another slippery slope, a deeper truth he can’t recall. And when young becomes old and cool turns to cold,…

we’ll see if the truth can set him free. Until then don’t cry for no hipster. He had his day and he had his night. And, I’ve got to conflate the ending — let’s call it what it is, in a world like his it’s usually the wrongs that make it right. That’s as close as I could come.
